title: vault.write_generated input
description: Machine markdown write confined to the configured generated vault namespace (the life folders: calendar, appointments, reminders, drafts among its areas). R2: the write is durable and confined; generated pages are reversible artifacts and pre-existing non-generated content is never touched. page_name is the FULL vault-relative page name including the generated namespace prefix; the handler refuses anything not beneath the configured namespace (traversal, symlink, and namespace escapes are typed refusals) and enforces the .md suffix at its own stricter bound. Alternatively, receipt_correlation_id alone names the original operation of one committed email.draft or calendar.propose effect of the caller's own seat and session: its derived receipt pages are rebuilt from that effect's durable record, never from caller text, and published without replacing existing different bytes. Credential material never travels in arguments; a missing vault root is typed unavailable.
